newsitem.title: USA: Gold Kist files with SEC on Golden deal.
newsitem.headline: Gold Kist files with SEC on Golden deal.

text.p: Gold Kist Inc said Friday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission its response to a request for further information on its pending purchase of the shares of Golden Poultry Co Inc it does not already own.
Gold Kist, an agricultureal cooperative based in Atlanta, said it now expects the deal to close in late August or September.
It said receiving SEC comments on proposed proxy materials and responding to them added more than a month to the estimated closing date.
Gold Kist said it began negotiations with Golden Poultry in January. In April the companies announced an agreement.
Gold Kist already owns about 75 percent of Golden Poultry's outstanding shares.
